'''Wom-Nii Gnaden''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who was serving as a [[Jedi General/Legends|general]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]]<ref name="ICS" /> sometime during or after [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Date" /> A skilled [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|348|Gnaden, Wom-Nii}}</ref> Gnaden fought in the [[Battle of Crombach Nebula/Legends|Battle]] of [[Crombach Nebula/Legends|Crombach Nebula]]<ref name="ICS" /> sometime between 22 and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> During that encounter, his<ref name="ICS" /> [[NTB-630 naval bomber/Legends|NTB-630 naval bomber]] was damaged and spun out of control, crashing into the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] called the ''[[Tide of Progress XII/Legends|Tide of Progress XII]]''. The crash [[Death/Legends|killed]] Gnaden<ref name="CSWE" /> and left damage still visible at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]<ref name="ICS" /> in 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="Date" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wom-Nii Gnaden was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]'', a [[2005]] reference book written by [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="ICS" />
